2608.02359.title: Fast and Accurate Quotation Attribution in Literary Texts
2608.02359.paper_summary: Attributing quotations to their speakers in literary texts remains an open challenge. Standard methods, which independently predict a speaker mention for each quotation, are efficient but still limited in accuracy. In contrast, large language model (LLM) approaches achieve strong performance, but their computational cost limits their use in large-scale literary analysis. We propose an encoder-based efficient formulation that resolves multiple quotation attributions within a shared, large context window. Using our new formulation, \textit{joint scoring}, we report state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on the Project Dialogism Novel Corpus (PDNC), comprising more than 35,000 manually annotated quotations from 22 English novels. Our best model reaches 94.5\% overall attribution accuracy while processing novels $20\times$ faster than comparable standard methods and more than $1000\times$ faster than LLM-based approaches on an A100 GPU. An analysis of models' representations suggests that joint scoring improves on challenging attribution examples by preserving long-range anaphora resolution signal, an information that we found already present in pretrained encoders. To facilitate adoption, we release ModernBookNLP, a modified fork of BookNLP that replaces its quotation attribution model with our best system available at https://github.com/gasmichel/ModernBookNLP_QA/.
2608.02359.paper_summary_zh: 在文學文本中將引用歸屬於其發言者仍然是一項未解的挑戰。標準方法獨立預測每個引用的發言者提及，雖然效率高但準確性仍然有限。相對而言，大型語言模型（LLM）方法表現強勁，但其計算成本限制了其在大規模文學分析中的使用。我們提出了一種基於編碼器的高效公式，能在共享的大上下文窗口內解決多個引用歸屬問題。使用我們的新公式，\textit{joint scoring}，我們在Project Dialogism Novel Corpus（PDNC）上報告了最先進的（SOTA）性能，該數據集包含來自22部英語小說的35,000多個手動標註的引用。我們的最佳模型在處理小說時達到94.5\%的整體歸屬準確率，速度比可比的標準方法快$20\times$，並且在A100 GPU上比基於LLM的方法快超過$1000\times$。對模型表示的分析表明，joint scoring通過保留長距離指代解析信號來改善挑戰性的歸屬示例，我們發現這種信息在預訓練編碼器中已經存在。為了促進採用，我們發布了ModernBookNLP，這是一個修改過的BookNLP分支，將其引用歸屬模型替換為我們在https://github.com/gasmichel/ModernBookNLP_QA/上提供的最佳系統。
